dedupe_keys.name: history of electricity consumption data in quebec by industry sector

description: History of electricity consumption data in Québec by industry sector is a series of datasets listed in Hydro-Québec open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Hydro-Québec. This Hydro Québec data represents electricity consumption for all consumption locations in Québec by industry sector. The data is updated once a year and has been available since 2016. Consumption data is provided by industry sector (agricultural, residential, commercial, institutional and industrial) for an administrative region (AR) in the province of Québec. Coverage: Québec (Hydro-Québec). The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Electricity consumption. The portal shows 595 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-12-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-donnees-hydroquebec-com-portal.
